items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves critical and important vulnerabilities, including an unauthenticated customer account takeover (CVE-2026-71362) and arbitrary code execution issues. Exploitation attempts for CVE-2026-71362 have been detected in the wild.

items.title: Unauthenticated Customer Account Takeover
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source allows unauthenticated attackers to switch customer sessions and hijack accounts. This flaw has a CVSS score of 9.1 and is being actively exploited.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This security update addresses critical and important vulnerabilities that could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system read, and application denial-of-service. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for these issues.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in Adobe Commerce could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: This high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in Adobe Commerce could lead to arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Security Feature Bypass (Adobe Commerce B2B)
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B could enable a security-feature bypass. Exploitation requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: This high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability could enable a security-feature bypass in Adobe Commerce. It requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges for exploitation.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update addresses critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.
